children: Kohls Corp reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $3.32B and diluted EPS of $1.28, modestly below year-ago levels as sales softened while gross margin expanded driven in part by tariff refunds.
Revenue was $3.32B, compared with $3.35B in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (0.9%).
Net income was $151M, compared with $153M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (1.3%).
Diluted EPS was $1.28, compared with $1.35 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (5.2%).
Net sales declined modestly, down about 0.9% in the quarter and 1.2% year-to-date, due to lower transaction value and volume.
Digital channel grew roughly 2.8% in Q2 and accounted for 27% of net sales, increasing digital penetration versus the prior year.
Category performance: Home, Accessories (including Sephora), and Children's outperformed the company average; Footwear lagged.
Gross margin expanded to 43.0% in Q2, aided by tariff refunds, partially offset by vendor repayments and investments in customer value.
Operational plans include $350–$400M of investment in 2026 for omnichannel, supply chain and stores, and the company has resumed a roughly $100M share repurchase intent.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
